# Salow Technologies (Salowtech) — Complete Technical & Architectural Overview

## 1. Company Identity & Engineering Doctrine
Salow Technologies (https://salowtech.com) is an enterprise software engineering studio based in Surat, Gujarat, India. We build sovereign software platforms that clients own outright:
- **100% Intellectual Property Ownership:** Full source code transfer, proprietary licenses, and zero recurring vendor lock-in.
- **Zero Per-Seat SaaS Taxes:** Custom-built systems eliminate escalating per-user subscription fees as teams scale.
- **Data Sovereignty & Security:** Self-hostable on private cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or on-premise) with PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) and AES-256 encryption.

## 2. Core Service Verticals & Technical Capabilities

### A. Custom CRM Development (https://salowtech.com/crm-development)
- **Overview:** Bespoke customer relationship management platforms tailored to specific sales, customer success, and lead lifecycle operations.
- **Lead Capture & Omnichannel Pipelines:** Instant webhook ingestion from Meta Ads, Google Ads, website quote forms, and WhatsApp Cloud API.
- **Sales Velocity Automation:** Automated lead qualification, SLA routing, and sub-5 minute inbound response automation.
- **Telephony & Communication Timeline:** Unified contextual timeline connecting VoIP call recordings, email correspondence, and WhatsApp chats.
- **Key FAQs:**
  * *Why build custom CRM instead of HubSpot/Salesforce?* Custom CRM gives 100% data ownership, zero monthly per-user licenses, and exact workflow fit.
  * *Can it integrate with WhatsApp & existing telephony?* Yes, native WhatsApp Cloud API and Twilio/SIP telephony integration.

### B. Enterprise ERP Development (https://salowtech.com/erp-development)
- **Overview:** Modular enterprise resource planning systems integrating inventory, manufacturing, accounting, procurement, and supply chain.
- **Operations & Manufacturing:** Multi-plant inventory control, bill of materials (BOM), real-time floor telemetry, and automated reorder triggers.
- **Financial Synchronization:** General ledger, automated GST / statutory invoicing, accounts payable/receivable, and automated audit trails.
- **Supply Chain Synchronization:** Vendor procurement portals, dynamic PO matching, and barcode/QR logistics tracking.
- **Key FAQs:**
  * *Can ERP scale across multiple branches/plants?* Yes, built on scalable multi-tenant or dedicated PostgreSQL schemas with distributed cache.
  * *How is legacy data migrated?* Structured ETL pipelines with automated validation and rollback checkpoints.

### C. Sovereign HRM & Payroll Software (https://salowtech.com/hrm-payroll)
- **Overview:** All-in-one human resources management and payroll automation engine with zero per-employee recurring fees.
- **Biometric & GPS Mobile Punch:** Facial scan verification and GPS geofenced mobile clock-in eliminating proxy attendance.
- **1-Click Compliant Payroll:** Automated statutory deductions for Provident Fund (PF), ESIC, Professional Tax (PT), and TDS.
- **Employee Self-Service (ESS):** Mobile portals for AES-256 encrypted payslips, leave approvals, and tax investment declarations.
- **Key FAQs:**
  * *Does it support shifts and overtime rules?* Yes, fully configurable rotational shift rosters, night allowances, and overtime policies.
  * *Is payroll calculation compliant with Indian labor laws?* Yes, 100% compliant with updated statutory tax brackets, PF, ESIC, and bonus norms.

### D. Conversational AI Voice Assistants (https://salowtech.com/ai-voice-assistant)
- **Overview:** Real-time conversational AI voice agents and smart chatbots handling 24/7 inbound calls, lead capture, and appointment scheduling.
- **Autonomous Telephony Agents:** Sub-500ms latency conversational AI voice bots for 24/7 inbound customer support and appointment booking.
- **Multilingual Neural Speech:** Custom-trained neural speech models handling diverse regional accents, industry terminology, and sentiment detection.
- **Instant CRM Integration:** Real-time call transcription, caller intent extraction, and automated CRM pipeline stage updates.
- **Key FAQs:**
  * *How natural does the AI sound?* Ultra-low latency (<500ms) with human-like breathing, interruptions, and contextual understanding.
  * *Can the AI transfer calls to a live human?* Yes, seamless call escalation and warm handover with caller context summary.

### E. Custom Web Application Development (https://salowtech.com/web-development)
- **Overview:** High-performance, secure web applications, customer portals, and SaaS dashboards built on modern React and Next.js architectures.
- **Architecture & Performance:** Modern frontend engineering, React, Next.js, sub-second TTFB, and zero-layout-shift (CLS = 0) render pipelines.
- **Enterprise Security:** Hardened CSP policies, OWASP Top 10 compliance, input sanitization, and automated audit logging.
- **Key FAQs:**
  * *Do we own the source code?* Yes, full IP and repository transfer upon deployment.
  * *How fast will the website load?* Sub-second load times with Core Web Vitals optimization (LCP < 2.5s, CLS = 0).

### F. Mobile Application Development (https://salowtech.com/mobile-app-development)
- **Overview:** Production-ready iOS, Android, and Flutter applications engineered for 120 FPS fluid interactions and offline reliability.
- **Native & Cross-Platform:** Native Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android), and Flutter cross-platform mobile apps.
- **Performance:** 120 FPS buttery-smooth UI rendering, offline-first SQLite/WatermelonDB caching, and sub-100ms API synchronization.
- **Key FAQs:**
  * *Does one codebase support both iOS and Android?* Yes, with Flutter or React Native, or native codebases based on your performance needs.
  * *Do you handle App Store and Play Store launch?* Yes, end-to-end certification, security reviews, and deployment.

### G. Technical SEO, AEO & GEO Growth Services (https://salowtech.com/seo-and-growth)
- **Overview:** Organic search engineering optimizing technical performance, keyword authority, and AI engine citation visibility (AEO/GEO/LLMO).
- **Core Web Vitals:** Sub-2.5s LCP, zero CLS, and sub-200ms INP optimization.
- **Answer Engine & Generative Engine Optimization:** Structured JSON-LD graphs, citation grounding for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- **Key FAQs:**
  * *What is GEO and AEO?* Generative Engine Optimization and Answer Engine Optimization structure your content so AI search agents cite your business directly.
  * *How long does organic SEO take?* Technical fixes yield speed and indexing gains within 3-4 weeks; competitive rankings typically compound within 3-6 months.
